scope: All 50 historical Magebean automation backlog requirements; actual implementation dispositions, not 47 completed requirements

remaining_adapters: Complete Magento route/role/ownership integration fixtures and protected-byte/side-effect oracles
Provider-specific webhook HMAC/replay contracts and installed version mapping

requirements.original_criterion: Code directories are read-only for the application runtime in the collected Magento deployment; assess effective runtime identity, permissions, ACLs and read-only mounts.
requirements.reason: Run scanner as the actual unprivileged worker identity; root or differing identity is unsupported rather than a violation. All worker PIDs to be assessed must be explicitly supplied; no discovery-completeness claim. Unsupported worker mode, nonzero seccomp filters, sticky parent rules, external links or missing /proc permissions yield UNKNOWN. No code writes or privilege changes are performed.

new_checks.title: Application worker code paths are read-only
new_checks.criterion: For every explicitly supplied PHP-FPM worker PID, the scanner and worker have identical effective UID/GID/groups, zero effective/permitted/ambient capabilities, matching project tree, mount namespace and Linux security context. Kernel access observations find no writable object or replaceable code root in the complete bounded configured app/vendor/lib inventory. Unsupported identity, seccomp, links or inventory gaps remain UNKNOWN.

requirements.original_title: No executable code in media or upload paths
requirements.original_criterion: No executable code in media or upload paths; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.reason: Default pub/media inventory is applicable without demanding absent optional import/export paths; explicitly add relevant roots. Payload bytes and response bodies are never emitted; path/line/signature label only. XML opening tags are not treated as PHP.

new_checks.title: Upload inventory has no configured PHP or handler signatures
new_checks.criterion: Within the complete bounded configured upload path inventory, readable files contain no explicit long PHP opening tags or configured htaccess script-handler signatures and no PHP-like executable filename extension. Missing/unreadable/oversized eligible files, unfollowed links and traversal-budget gaps remain UNKNOWN. This is a signature policy, not absence of arbitrary executable content or prevention of server execution.

requirements.original_criterion: Checkout Content Security Policy enforced; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.reason: A redirect because no cart/session exists is UNKNOWN, not missing-CSP FAIL. Only named response is assessed; no checkout-wide or full browser execution guarantee. No state-changing requests, login, purchase or retained cookie/body content. Conservative explicit baseline can flag supported nonce plus unsafe-inline compatibility policy; title/criterion state exact Magebean policy, not universal CSP security judgment.

new_checks.title: Named checkout response emits the explicit enforced CSP baseline
new_checks.criterion: The supplied checkout path returns a successful same-origin no-redirect HTTPS GET with one unambiguous enforced Content-Security-Policy. The emitted policy explicitly defines script-src, connect-src, frame-src, form-action, object-src and base-uri; assessed sources contain no wildcard, unsafe-inline, unsafe-eval or broad scheme-only source. object-src is exactly none, base-uri is exactly none or self, and reporting is present when configured. Report-only alone fails; redirect/inaccessible checkout, multiple policies, unsupported syntax or incomplete collection remain UNKNOWN.

requirements.original_criterion: Security headers baseline enforced; assess only the collected Magento deployment scope.
requirements.reason: Nosniff plus existing HSTS/frame controls is not a claim of every security header on every route. No source-file union is used; runtime headers are collected directly with peer verification and bounded memory.

new_checks.title: Observed application response emits nosniff
new_checks.criterion: One successful same-origin no-redirect HTTPS GET at the configured path emits exactly one X-Content-Type-Options header whose trimmed value is nosniff. Missing or invalid header on an observed successful response fails; duplicate headers, redirects, transport failures and incomplete collection remain UNKNOWN. HSTS and frame protection are assessed separately.

new_checks.title: Configured PHP-FPM workers have no mapped Xdebug binary module

No Xdebug-named shared module is mapped in these verified workers. Missing or changed identity, empty/unreadable/truncated maps or malformed inventory remain UNKNOWN. This observes configured process mappings at scan time, not every deployment worker, Xdebug feature mode, statically linked code or complete PHP runtime settings.
